title: Name a value
summary: Elixir: Name a value. Use 6 pencils. Try a small example and check what happens.
introduction: A name can be bound to a value. The plus sign adds numbers. Read the example, then check the result.

blocks.text: Install Elixir. Save each example as lesson.exs and run elixir lesson.exs.
The binding names 3. Adding 2 makes a separate result, 5.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Values are not changed in place; a new binding is different from mutation.
